amendment_rule: Thresholds change only by explicit project-owner approval before candidate evaluation, with a recorded new policy_version; the optimizing model may not lower them after seeing results.

baseline_roles.B-main: unmodified actual kickoff main built with recorded locked settings; historical end-to-end impact and preservation reference
baseline_roles.B-source: predeclared correct/buildable feature or rescue producer per eligible scenario; nonregression of inherited useful behavior, never a broken or deliberately slow source
baseline_roles.B-unified: first independently accepted complete consolidation before new RFC optimizations, selected by the frozen rule; primary denominator for new implementation speedups
baseline_roles.F: final assembled candidate, then rebuilt actual landed revision; must meet equivalent-work correctness, resource, latency and source-closure gates

exclusion_rules: exclusions are defined before observing candidate results
exclude only objectively invalid protocol violations and retain the reason in the audit record
keep every valid raw sample, including slower runs
any rerun follows the complete frozen procedure and remains in the audit record
inconclusive bounds are not passes; fixed additional collection may be authorized prospectively
gate_declaration_rule: a run must declare in gates_evaluated every gate bound to a scenario it covers, and a run covering every PERF-SUITE scenario must declare PERF-SUITE; run-declared gate subsets cannot skip a mandatory gate

gates.description: On the frozen primary directory-heavy, cold-application/warm-filesystem, identity-only discovery scenario under the throughput profile, U95(R) <= 0.75: at least 25% elapsed-time reduction supported by the defined bound.
Across the predeclared primary identity-only discovery suite, upper bound on equal-weight geometric-mean elapsed-time ratio <= 0.85: material aggregate reduction, not one cherry-picked win.
Each frozen critical existing-behavior scenario, including low-impact scans, cached CLI queries, reconciliation, report/event/output paths and applicable native fallback, has U95(R) <= 1.05.
gates.reference: B-unified plus predeclared eligible B-main/B-source per scenario

gates.applies_to: native accelerator per capability/scope class versus reference walker
gates.description: A native accelerator may be automatically selected for a capability/scope class only after exact correctness/coverage qualification and U95(R_native/reference) <= 0.90 for that class; otherwise keep it experimental/disabled or use the walker.
Every measured profile passes its frozen byte/item/FD/admission/helper budgets; the original low-impact caps are retained rather than expanded to get green.
All applicable structural work-budget integration assertions pass (goal section 7.2).

host_classes.lease: one exclusive benchmark lease per physical host/device

ratio_definition: R = F elapsed time / B-unified elapsed time under identical semantics. U95(R) is the predeclared simultaneous one-sided 95% upper confidence bound. For explicitly identified nonregression/source/promotion comparisons, the separately frozen eligible reference is used; B-main is never silently substituted for B-unified.

repeated_run_protocol.block_order: randomized balanced baseline/candidate order within paired blocks
repeated_run_protocol.invalid_duration_handling: zero, negative, or missing durations and nonzero sample exit codes make the run INVALID_EVIDENCE; samples are never silently dropped
repeated_run_protocol.multiplicity_method: joint bootstrap over the declared gate family
repeated_run_protocol.short_operation_rule: short operations use fixed blocks of repeated CLI launches; per-launch and block data are recorded and correlation is accounted for
repeated_run_protocol.stop_rule: fixed sample size selected before candidate evaluation; no early stop on a green bound and no selective repetition

throughput.notes: documented throughput profile with frozen numeric budgets; placeholders are filled from the baseline-only pilot and frozen before candidate evaluation

sample_size_selection.description: Baseline-only pilot runs establish dataset scales, measurable-but-not-exhausting runtimes, and the final fixed sample size before any candidate is evaluated; the winner's best dataset is never selected afterward.
